Held up for clear running making the Home Turn and near the 300 Metres improved into a narrow run between MULTIDUTCH and TURF PHOENIX and as a result made contact with TURF PHOENIX.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. H Bentley was reprimanded in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height near the 200 Metres.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 350 Metres and the 250 Metres.

Bumped at the start.  Near the 450 Metres was bumped by TURF PHOENIX which shifted out slightly and as a result blundered.  Near the 100 Metres was hampered when taken wider by MODEST GENTLEMAN.  J Orman stated that although his mount was bumped near the 450 Metres and again near the 350 Metres he was of the opinion the horse would be better suited by being stepped up in distance to 1200 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

On jumping was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.  H Bowman stated that after being crossed by SMART ENGINEER near the 500 Metres his mount did not travel well thereafter before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
On jumping was steadied when crowded by TURF PHOENIX which shifted out abruptly.

D Probert stated that he was given the option of taking up a forward position.  Trainer K W Lui confirmed the instructions issued and stated that with blinkers being applied for the first time he had asked for the horse to be ridden forward.

Jumped awkwardly and made contact with the left side of its starting gate.  As a result TURF PHOENIX then shifted out and made heavy contact with HAPPY BOYS.  Shifted out near the 450 Metres and was bumped.  Bumped near the 300 Metres.  Near the 150 Metres, when giving ground, was steadied when crowded between MODEST GENTLEMAN and CONCORDE STAR, both of which shifted ground.
No report.

Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Near the 700 Metres shifted out and made contact with FAMILY FORTUNE when being steadied to avoid HARRY’S HERO.  Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, THUNDER BLINK will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

From the 900 Metres commenced a forward move and raced wide and without cover thereafter. A Badel was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 4 consecutive strides after the 150 Metres. Sent for sampling post-race.
Held up for clear running on the Home Turn.
No report.

Approaching the 700 Metres THUNDER BLINK improved into a three wide position behind HARRY’S HERO.  A short distance later THUNDER BLINK then shifted out when being steadied to avoid HARRY’S HERO and made contact with FAMILY FORTUNE, resulting in FAMILY FORTUNE being taken wider.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Passing the 1500 Metres STRONGEST BOY improved to the inside of FAMILY FORTUNE as that runner was being shifted in.  As a consequence STRONGEST BOY was steadied to avoid FAMILY FORTUNE.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

M F Poon stated that the intention was to lead the event.  He said after jumping only fairly and then being bumped heavily by DOUBLE SHOW which shifted in LUCKY BLESSING settled further back than intended.
No report.
Between the 300 Metres and the 100 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Before being allowed to race again, SOMETHING JONAH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Shifted in on jumping and was bumped.  Over the final 150 Metres could not be ridden out when positioned behind TSUEN WAN GLORY.  L Hewitson stated that along the Back Straight when HARRY’S HERO  commenced a forward move this resulted in DOUBLE SHOW being placed in restricted room between a number of runners around him. horses.incident_text: Near the 1000 Metres was momentarily crowded by SUPERB KING which lay in and away from HAYDAY.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped on jumping and became unbalanced.  Leaving the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid HAYDAY (Apprentice E C W Wong) which shifted in when not clear.  Apprentice Wong was advised to exercise more care.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with WHOWROTETHATSONG.
Jumped only fairly.
No report.
Near the 500 Metres commenced to race keenly and was steadied away from REGROWTH WINNER.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on THE PERFECT MATCH at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, THE PERFECT MATCH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
In the early stages lay in, resulting in its rider having to correct his mount near the 1000 Metres.

Jumped awkwardly.  When questioned A Badel stated that from the outside barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  He said TACTICAL COMMAND lay out throughout the race and in the Home Straight when placed under pressure continued to lay out.  He added whilst his preference was to improve to the inside of SWEET BRIAR near the 150 Metres, as TACTICAL COMMAND was laying out, he elected to allow it to continue to shift out to the outside of SWEET BRIAR rather than fight the horse which resulted in TACTICAL COMMAND not being able to be ridden out to the finish when positioned close to ACE POWER.

On jumping was bumped and became unbalanced.  Approaching the 900 Metres lay in when racing keenly and as a result was steadied away from GOR GOR.  Near the 500 Metres lay in and was steadied to avoid GOR GOR.
Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by SUPERB KING.  Near the 50 Metres was eased to avoid TACTICAL COMMAND which shifted out.
Approaching the 1000 Metres raced tight to the inside of SWEET BRIAR which lay in despite the efforts of its rider.

Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running.  H Bowman stated that the instructions were to ride the horse where comfortable.  He said with COPARTNER FLEET dropping back in distance to 1000 Metres tonight, when a number of runners showed superior pace he allowed the horse to settle in a midfield position.  Trainer K W Lui confirmed the instructions issued and stated that with the horse dropping back in distance tonight he asked Jockey Bowman not to make use of it in the early stages as it had raced in a disappointing manner at its previous race starts when being ridden forward.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Held up for clear running making the Home Turn.  Approaching the 200 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running when improving into a narrow run to the inside of SUPER SIXTY.
Shortly after the start was crowded between BEAUTY THUNDER and SIR CHARGE which shifted in.

Jumped awkwardly.  In the middle stages raced keenly and for some distance after the 600 Metres was steadied to avoid BEAUTY THUNDER.  Between the 300 Metres and 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  K C Leung stated that, in his opinion, the horse would be better suited by being stepped back up in distance to 1200 Metres.  He added after the race the horse was coughing.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, FUN ELITE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of M F Poon, 7th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ensure that he fully rides his mounts out to the finish of the race.
After being crossed by ZOUPER FELLOW near the 700 Metres commenced to race keenly and was steadied to avoid that runner.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  Near the 600 Metres was steadied to avoid HAPPY UNITED when being shifted behind that runner in an attempt to obtain cover.  When unable to obtain cover GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Shortly after the start was bumped by GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP which shifted in.  In the middle stages raced keenly and for some distance near the 500 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP.  Leaving the 200 Metres was shifted to the inside of SIR CHARGE to continue into clear running.  L Hewitson stated that from a wide barrier he was asked to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages as it had been racing in a disappointing manner when ridden in a forward position.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted out shortly after the start and bumped THE AZURE.

When questioned L Ferraris stated that the instructions were to lead the event.  He said after crossing to the front approaching the first turn he allowed KA YING GLORY to continue to stride along as he was concerned if he applied too much pressure to the horse it would hang out as it did at its last start.  He said after passing the 1100 Metres he applied some pressure to the horse, however, it commenced to lay out and therefore he was reluctant to restrain the horse and allowed it to continue to stride along.  He said although he was aware the pace he was setting was inside of standard time he felt it was in the best interests of the horse’s chances in the race not to restrain it to avoid it hanging out.  Trainer D A Hayes confirmed the instructions were to lead and as the horse hung out at its previous race start to not overly restrain KA YING GLORY to allow it to settle comfortably.  He said whilst he issued these instructions he was of the opinion that Jockey Ferraris could have made a greater effort to set a more sustainable pace during the middle stages of the event.  After considering the evidence the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Ferraris were reasonable in the circumstances.
No report.

When questioned M Guyon stated that his mount jumped only fairly and then shortly after was checked when crowded between CELTIC TIMES and CALIFORNIA BAY which shifted out and away from KA YING GLORY which resulted in his mount settling back in the field.  He said making the Home Turn he was reluctant to make a wide run as he felt it would be difficult to make up ground due to the early and middle stages being run inside of standard time.  He said as a result he elected to remain racing behind TO INFINITY and to shift to that runner’s inside where it obtained clear running approaching the 300 Metres.  He added in the Home Straight THE AZURE lay in and near the 150 Metres became awkwardly placed close to GENERAL REDWOOD when that runner shifted out slightly.  He said after improving to the outside of GENERAL REDWOOD leaving the 50 Metres he was obliged to steady and shift to the outside of CALIFORNIA BAY when that runner commenced to give ground.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of M Guyon, 7th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ensure that he fully rides his mounts out to the finish of the race.

L Hewitson stated that his mount, which was having its first race start at Happy Valley, raced greenly and making the turn near the 550 Metres hung out and was checked to avoid SAME TO YOU.  When questioned L Hewitson stated that making the Home Turn he committed to following THUNDER PRINCE as he felt that horse would give him a good opportunity to improve into the race.  He said as he committed to the outside of JUSTIFYING to follow THUNDER PRINCE, JUSTIFYING shifted out which presented a run to that horse’s inside.  He said as he was to the outside of JUSTIFYING he elected to continue to follow THUNDER PRINCE but his mount had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 300 Metres and the 150 Metres when THUNDER PRINCE did not improve as he had expected it would.

Whilst the Stewards acknowledged that HONEST WITNESS had hung in at that stage L Ferraris was severely reprimanded and advised he would be required to make a greater effort than he did on this occasion to straighten his mounts when they shift ground whilst not clear.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

horses.incident_text: Shifted in on jumping, made contact with GOLDENTRONICMIGHTY and became unbalanced.  From a wide barrier was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. <29/1/2026 Additional Veterinary Report>DOUBLE MONEY, which performed poorly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. DOUBLE MONEY was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer C S Shum this morning. He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right front leg. Before being allowed to race again, DOUBLE MONEY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
